mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.product_type, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.category_level, c.sort_order, c.enabled, c.medical_flag, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND s.status = 'open' AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND owner.status = 'normal' THEN 1 END) AS item_count FROM product_categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 'on' LEFT JOIN shops AS s ON s.id = p.shop_id LEFT JOIN users AS owner ON owner.id = s.owner_id WHERE c.product_type = #{productType} AND c.enabled = 1 GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.category_level ASC, c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.product_type, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.category_level, c.sort_order, c.enabled, c.medical_flag, 0 AS item_count FROM product_categories AS c WHERE c.id = #{id}
